title: Vintage Shabby Christmas Paper Bundle
author: MashMashStickers
description:
VINTAGE CHRISTMAS DIGITAL PAPER BUNDLE – Set of 15
Embrace the cozy and vintage charm of the season with our Shabby Christmas Digital Paper Bundle. This collection features 15 delightful digital papers, each adorned with rustic and shabby-chic Christmas patterns, perfect for infusing your creative projects with a touch of nostalgia. Versatile and heartwarming, these backgrounds are ideal for paper crafts, digital designs, sublimation, invitation cards, junk journaling, scrapbooking, and more.
🎄 Vintage Coziness:
Step into a world of shabby-chic holiday magic with our Shabby Christmas Digital Paper Bundle. Each digital paper is a celebration of rustic elegance, featuring distressed textures, muted colors, and charming Christmas patterns that evoke the warmth of yesteryears. Create projects that capture the enduring beauty of vintage Christmas.
🌈 Versatile Applications:
Designed for versatility, this bundle is your shabby-chic companion for a range of creative projects. Whether you’re crafting rustic holiday invitations, designing digital Christmas cards, or adding a touch of vintage charm to your scrapbook or junk journal, these digital papers provide a nostalgic canvas for your imagination.
🎨 Perfect for:
* Rustic holiday invitations and stationery
* Digital Christmas crafts with a vintage touch
* Sublimation
* Junk journaling
* Scrapbooking
* Paper crafts and more
💡 How to Use:
Infuse your projects with the vintage coziness of Shabby Christmas by seamlessly incorporating these digital papers. The high-resolution images ensure that every shabby-chic detail is vividly captured, allowing you to create heartwarming and nostalgic pieces that bring a touch of yesteryear to the holiday season.
Celebrate the season with our Shabby Christmas Digital Paper Bundle. Download now and let the shabby-chic patterns inspire your festive creations. Make this holiday season a journey back to the timeless elegance of vintage Christmas.”
✨ What’s Included:
* Set of 15 unique digital papers in PNG format
* Size: 12″ x 12″ / 3600 x 3600 px
* 300 dpi resolution
